articles.title: Constable Accused of Rape on Promise of Marriage in Meerut: Woman’s Allegations Rock
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking case has surfaced from the Brahmpuri police station area of Meerut, where a woman has accused a married police constable Vivek Chaudhary of raping her under the pretext of marriage.

body.html:
Meerut (Uttar Pradesh): A shocking case has surfaced from the Brahmpuri police station area of Meerut, where a woman has accused a married police constable Vivek Chaudhary of raping her under the pretext of marriage. The accused, currently posted as an assistant to CO Daulatabad, is alleged to have maintained physical relations with the woman after assuring her of marriage, but later refused to fulfil his promise.

Following the woman’s complaint, a major uproar has erupted within the Meerut Police Department, and the case has now been handed over to CO Brahmpuri Soumya Asthana for a detailed investigation.

According to reports, the incident traces back to a year ago when the constable was posted at the Brahmpuri police station. At that time, the woman’s relative had been detained in a case, leading to her acquaintance with the constable. During this period, the two began communicating, and the constable allegedly developed a physical relationship with her on the promise of marriage.

The woman, a mother of two children, has alleged that when she insisted he marry her, the constable refused and began avoiding her. She subsequently filed a complaint with the SSP, Meerut, accusing him of betrayal.

After the allegations, the constable was transferred to Kankarkheda police station and later appointed as an associate to CO Daulatabad. Investigating officer CO Soumya Asthana confirmed that the case had been looked into earlier, and the woman had then submitted a written refusal to take action.

This time, the constable has reportedly submitted an audio recording to the investigating officer, purportedly featuring a conversation between him and the complainant. Authorities said the audio evidence will be examined as part of the probe.

CO Daulatabad, Prakash Chandra Agarwal, stated that the accused constable is currently on leave, and further steps will be taken once the investigation report is received.

This case has once again raised serious questions about misconduct within the police force and abuse of authority in sensitive situations.

articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: JODHPUR — A heart-wrenching incident from Samrau area under Osian police station limits has sparked outrage and debate over changing social values. A young woman left her home to live in a live-in relationship with her boyfriend, leaving her parents in tears.

body.html:
JODHPUR — A heart-wrenching incident from Samrau area under Osian police station limits has sparked outrage and debate over changing social values. A young woman left her home to live in a live-in relationship with her boyfriend, leaving her parents in tears.

A viral video from the scene shows the girl walking away, while her mother cries uncontrollably, pleading for her to stay. Despite her parents’ emotional appeals, the daughter chose to leave, saying she wished to live with the boy.

Locals describe the incident as a reflection of the growing disconnect between modern youth and traditional family values. Many are questioning how children raised with love and dreams could turn away from their parents in such a manner.

Residents of the area have expressed concern, calling it a sad picture of today’s Kaliyuga, where many youngsters abandon their aging parents to pursue relationships, ignoring their family’s pain.

Police from the Osian police station confirmed that no criminal complaint has been filed so far, as the girl is an adult and left of her own will.

The incident has reignited a social debate on live-in relationships, parental respect, and moral responsibility in today’s generation.

articles.title: Foreign Students’ Shocking Video from Ludhiana Goes Viral, Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | In Ludhiana two foreign students engaging in obscene acts on the roof of a moving car near Keys Hotel, Tharike. The act continued for nearly a kilometre as stunned onlookers watched and filmed.

body.html:
#InShort | In Ludhiana two foreign students engaging in obscene acts on the roof of a moving car near Keys Hotel, Tharike. The act continued for nearly a kilometre as stunned onlookers watched and filmed. Police have launched an investigation — the car is registered in Jalandhar, and efforts are on to trace those involved. Locals allege such indecent behaviour by foreign students has become common in the area.

* * *

A viral video from Ludhiana, Punjab, has sparked outrage after two foreign students were seen engaging in obscene acts on the roof of a moving car. The incident reportedly took place on the road behind Keys Hotel near Tharike, a locality known for a large concentration of foreign students.

In the viral clip, one man can be seen driving the car, while two students — believed to be of African descent — perform indecent acts on the car’s roof as it moves for nearly one kilometre. Several others were seated inside the vehicle, while people in another car following them captured the incident on video. Shocked passersby stopped to watch the scene unfold.

Local residents allege that such behaviour has become increasingly common in the area, with foreign students often seen performing stunts and inappropriate acts on public roads.

Police Begin Investigation
The video has now reached the Ludhiana Police, who have begun verifying details. Sunita, Traffic In-Charge of Zone 6, said the car’s registration number is being checked to trace those involved. The vehicle is reportedly registered with the Jalandhar RTO and was purchased about a year ago.

Authorities suspect the students are from Jalandhar, where many foreign nationals study, and that they had come to Ludhiana to meet friends. Police said the students will be identified and action will be taken as per law.

The incident has raised concerns about public indecency and road safety violations, with many demanding stricter monitoring of such areas known for frequent nuisance acts.

articles.title: Nursing Student Pushed Off 3rd-Floor Balcony by Live-In Partner, CCTV Footage Exposes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case from Patna’s Ashokpuri area has sent shockwaves across Bihar. Sophia Parveen alias Rukhsar (22), a nursing student, was allegedly pushed off the third-floor balcony of Soho Nirmala Apartments by her live-in partner, Amit Kumar.

body.html:
A shocking case from Patna’s Ashokpuri area has sent shockwaves across Bihar. Sophia Parveen alias Rukhsar (22), a nursing student, was allegedly pushed off the third-floor balcony of Soho Nirmala Apartments by her live-in partner, Amit Kumar.

CCTV footage that has now gone viral shows Rukhsar plunging from the building and hitting a nearby school’s boundary wall before collapsing to the ground. Investigators say Amit then carried her blood-soaked body in an auto-rickshaw to IGIMS Hospital, where he dumped her on a stretcher and fled—all of which was captured on hospital CCTV cameras.

Police have confirmed that Amit rented the flat on September 9 using a fake Aadhaar card, claiming he and Rukhsar were married. The landlord later verified that the documents were forged.

Rukhsar’s family, who live in Bhangha Balua village in Bettiah, learned of her death three days later when her childhood friend saw her photo in a Dainik Bhaskar news report. Her sister, Shabana Khatun, said Rukhsar had introduced Amit as a police officer and that the family had trusted him completely.

“He came to our home, claimed to work in the police, and took my sister with him to Patna. We believed him,” Shabana said tearfully. “He should be punished just as brutally as he killed her.”

Police investigations revealed that Rukhsar and Amit had been living together for over a month. On September 30 at around 4:12 PM, Amit allegedly pushed Rukhsar from their third-floor balcony, causing her instant death. Instead of seeking help from nearby hospitals, he travelled 7 km to IGIMS, apparently to delay detection.

The Danapur police have registered a case of murder, and a manhunt has been launched for Amit Kumar. A lookout notice has also been issued for the auto driver who helped him transport the body.

Forensic teams have inspected the flat and found scattered clothes but no sign of Amit. The case has sparked outrage on social media, with many demanding swift justice and questioning safety for women in live-in relationships.

articles.title: Unnao Inspector Suspended for Reporting Drunk on Duty, Assaulting Locals at Ramlila Fair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Unnao, UP — An inspector was suspended after being caught drunk while on duty during the Ravan fair at Ramlila Maidan. Identified as Harendra Singh, he was deployed on QRT duty when locals filmed him in an intoxicated state.

body.html:
Unnao, UP — An inspector was suspended after being caught drunk while on duty during the Ravan fair at Ramlila Maidan. Identified as Harendra Singh, he was deployed on QRT duty when locals filmed him in an intoxicated state. Angered by this, he allegedly slapped the bystanders, leading to a scuffle in which the public beat him up.

Taking cognizance of the viral video, SP Jai Prakash Singh ordered immediate suspension of the inspector and initiated a departmental inquiry.

Unnao Police confirmed that a case has been registered at Kotwali Sadar Police Station under relevant sections. Two people involved in the assault have been detained.
